description: Implementation of the Device.WiFi.Radio.Stats API, including functions to retrieve WiFi radio statistics such as bytes sent/received, packet counts, errors, noise floor, and managing instances of WiFi radio stats objects.

classes.name: hostIf_WiFi_Radio_Stats
classes.description: Class representing WiFi radio statistics, with methods to retrieve various metrics and manage instances.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieve or create an instance of WiFi radio stats for a given device ID.

methods.name: closeInstance
methods.description: Delete a specific WiFi radio stats instance.

methods.name: closeAllInstances
methods.description: Delete all existing WiFi radio stats instances.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_Radio_Stats_BytesSent
methods.description: Get the number of bytes sent over WiFi radio.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_Radio_Stats_BytesReceived
methods.description: Get the number of bytes received over WiFi radio.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_Radio_Stats_PacketsSent
methods.description: Get the count of packets sent.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_Radio_Stats_PacketsReceived
methods.description: Get the count of packets received.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_Radio_Stats_ErrorsSent
methods.description: Get the count of errors sent.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_Radio_Stats_ErrorsReceived
methods.description: Get the count of errors received.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_Radio_Stats_DiscardPacketsSent
methods.description: Get the count of discarded packets sent.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_Radio_Stats_DiscardPacketsReceived
methods.description: Get the count of discarded packets received.
